meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析你 GitHub 仓库中所有开放的 Issue 和 PR。它会为每个问题生成一份带有 GitHub 永久链接证据的报告，存放在临时文件夹。整个过程只读取数据，绝不执行任何修改。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请帮我 triage 这个仓库的所有开放 Issue。
say.note: 触发对所有未关闭 Issue 的分析。
启动完整 triage 流程。
触发对每个 PR 的分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze all open issues and PRs in your GitHub repository. It generates a detailed report for each item, saved to a temporary folder, with every claim backed by a GitHub permalink. It never writes to GitHub (no comments, no merges, no labels).
howto.when_en: When you say keywords like "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs", or "github triage", or ask to analyze all open issues/PRs.

say_en.text: Please triage all open issues in this repository.
say_en.note: Triggers analysis of all open issues.
